barbers.subtitle: Each professional: their name, how they look on your site and how they get paid.

barbers.bioHint: What they are good at. It shows on your public page.

team.title: Team and permissions
team.subtitle: Who gets into the panel, with which role, and exactly what they can do.
team.empty: You are the only one in the panel.
team.linkedBarberHint: Linking a barber lets the system know which appointments and commissions are theirs.
team.emailHint: They sign in with this email. It cannot be changed later.
team.emailLocked: The email is their sign in and cannot be edited. If it changed, deactivate and add them again.
team.createdBody: Give this temporary password to {name}. It is shown only once.
team.createdHint: Ask them to change it as soon as they sign in.
team.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They lose access, but everything they recorded stays.
team.onlyOwnerAssignsOwner: Only the owner can name another owner.
team.roleChangeResetsOverrides: Changing the role resets their permissions to the new role defaults.
team.branchAccessBody: Check which locations they can enter besides their own.
team.branchAccessOwner: Owner: sees the whole chain without checking anything.

perms.title: Permissions for {name}
perms.explainBody: Check what this person should be able to do. What you see is exactly what the system will allow: nothing hidden behind it.
perms.summaryInherits: Inherits everything from {role}. If the role gains a new permission tomorrow, they get it too.
perms.resetHint: Drops every exception and inherits from {role} again.
perms.lockedTitle: Per person permissions are on the Professional plan
perms.lockedBody: On your {plan} plan the factory roles apply. You can still see what each role includes, and you can always go back to role permissions.
perms.selfWarning: You cannot remove team administration from yourself.

branches.title: Locations
branches.subtitle: Your shops, who gets into each one, and which one you are working in.
branches.limitFull: You reached the limit of your {plan} plan.
branches.lockedTitle: Multi location is on the Professional plan
branches.lockedBody: With Professional you open new shops, give your people access per shop, and see the whole chain from one panel.
branches.nameShortHint: This is how you will see it in the switcher and in reports.
branches.fullNameHint: The one that shows on its public page.
branches.fullNameLockedMain: The main shop name is changed in Settings.
branches.timezoneHint: It drives schedules and register closings for that location.
branches.hoursBody: Hours are set per barber from the Calendar: a location is open when someone has a schedule.
branches.confirmClose: Close {name}? It stops operating, but nothing is deleted.
branches.cannotCloseMain: The main shop cannot be closed from here.
branches.consolidatedBody: {branches} locations · {barbers} barbers · {users} people in the panel
branches.switchWarning: Switching location reloads the whole panel so nothing from the previous one stays on screen.
